chapter: Cab Calloway, Haiti and Sarah Vaughan
title: First marriage, a miscarriage, and sons born three days apart
summary: Budd's first wife lost a child, and after both remarried they each had sons days apart; they stay good friends.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you have any children by your first marriage, Budd?

My first wife had a miscarriage, and a funny thing about this, it isn't funny, but I'm sayin', after we were divorced, I got married again, and she got married again. And we both had boys, and they are seven days apart.
My son was born on September the 10th. Her son was born on -- no, they're not seven days apart. It was the 7th. They're three days apart.
Three days apart. I know you all are good friends today.
We're the best of friends right today.
Everytime I go to Chicago, I go over to the house. She cooks me my favorite meal. We go around to see all of our old friends that we knew when we were married, you know. It's nice.
